newsitem.title: FRANCE: Counci of Europe suggests women's rights overseer.
newsitem.headline: Counci of Europe suggests women's rights overseer.

text.p: The president of the Council of Europe's parliamentary assembly, Leni Fischer, on Saturday proposed the creation of an "ombudsperson" to protect the rights of women.

In a letter marking international women's day sent to parliamentary speakers of the council's 40 member states and four candidate states, she said the ombudsperson would make proposals to overcome inequality between sexes throughout the continent.
The holder of the new post would also have a role to play in fighting the rise in the trafficking of prostitutes, a crime which Fischer said should be punished as harshly as drug-trafficking.
Fischer, 62, a German, last year became the first woman elected to head the assembly of the Council of Europe which monitors democracy and human rights in Europe.
